infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Bob Mobile uses your photo library only when you attach an image to a prompt.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Bob Mobile uses your location only when you enable it for nearby searches or route planning.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Bob Mobile to select images that you choose to attach to a prompt.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Bob Mobile to use your location for nearby searches and route planning.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Bob Mobile to record voice prompts that you choose to send to Bob Work.
